calls.reasoning: Over two weeks the NVDA-MSFT return gap has no reliable direction, so the median is near 0. MSFT hit a two-month low of ~$496 on AI-cost doubts. A permanent-CEO announcement could fall in the window, so the tails are fat (~3% priced beyond each of ±15). No human market found on Polymarket, Manifold or Kalshi.
